scope: Public Svelte component and pattern exports from ts/src/components/index.ts and ts/src/patterns/index.ts. Utility and type-only exports are intentionally excluded from this batch.

decision.poodle_gap_rule: If a migration reveals missing primitive or generic composite behavior, add it to Poodle instead of preserving the gap inside a long-lived Underlay wrapper.
decision.poodle_ergonomics_rule: If a surface clearly belongs in a design system but Poodle's current API, styling constraints, or interaction model make common application workflows awkward, extend Poodle rather than retaining a second canonical Underlay implementation.

candidate_for_poodle_when: The surface is domain-neutral and can be named without Underlay portfolio nouns or workflow assumptions.
The surface represents a stable component contract rather than a product page assembly.
The surface is likely to recur across multiple apps and runtime targets.
The surface primarily expresses UI structure, interaction, accessibility, and theming.
The surface remains a Poodle candidate even when it needs contract, behavior, or styling improvement to fit everyday workflows cleanly.
keep_in_underlay_when: The surface is primarily a website shell, admin shell, operational flow, or product-oriented page composition.
The surface binds together generic parts with portfolio-specific workflow logic.
The surface carries auth-policy, recovery-flow, or other orchestration assumptions that are not clean design-system contracts.

keep_in_underlay.notes: Retain as an Underlay-owned workflow surface.

Retain as Underlay-owned structural shells, operational flows, or app-facing product composites. `PageHeader` is now reserved for richer section/title split, contextual-back, banner, and header-meta cases after the simple title/back/actions, count-bearing list headers, and plain upload/detail pages moved to Poodle `PageHeader`. `FormDialog` remains the flexible modal-form workflow shell for custom body/actions, but now resolves its close and status chrome through Poodle `IconButton` and `Callout` rather than a second local implementation. `RelationPickerDialog` remains the relation-selection workflow shell, but its modal, search, status, and action chrome now resolve through Poodle `Dialog`, `SearchField`, `Callout`, and `Button` instead of a second local modal stack.

delete.notes: Retire entirely. The structural bar family had no live shared-source or consuming-app callers beyond its own harness/test, so preserving it as a retained Underlay vocabulary would only keep dead surface area alive.
Retire entirely. The restore-resolution workflow family had no live shared-source or consuming-app callers beyond its own tests, so it did not earn a retained Underlay workflow boundary.

Retire entirely. These were thin local framing wrappers around card and grid layout with no meaningful external workflow contract. `AiRoutingAdmin` and the review surface now compose directly over Poodle `Card` and local layout.

Retire entirely. The account-settings trio had no live consuming-app callers and no shared-source consumers beyond its own dedicated passkey-manager test, so it did not earn a retained public auth-settings contract.
Retire entirely. The section shell had only two live callers and no independent workflow contract; both callers now compose directly over local heading/layout markup and Poodle primitives.

Retire entirely. The header-metadata wrapper family had only four edit-page callers and no independent workflow contract; those callers now compose directly over the existing `DetailMeta*` helpers plus `Code`.
Retire as a public export. `FormShell` no longer has direct consuming-app callers and remains only as an internal implementation detail behind `SpaFormShell`.
Retire entirely. Poodle now owns the generic modal and confirmation surface, including close-button support, surface-class hooks, and async confirm handling.

resolve_via_existing_poodle_surface.notes: Use `Pill` with the badge-style appearance. No new Poodle component is required.
Use the standard Poodle `Button` with `variant="ghost"`. No separate text-button contract is needed.
Use Poodle skeleton presets and composition instead of recreating an Underlay-specific wrapper.
Remove the Underlay surface entirely. Treat save semantics as caller-owned labels, hidden intent fields, and actions over standard Poodle `Button` and `SplitButton` primitives.
The metric-tile surface appears to cover the generic metric-card use case without a new Poodle contract.
Use `MetricTile` composed in layout primitives rather than minting a dedicated stat-grid surface immediately.
Treat this as checkbox-plus-chip styling composed from existing Poodle primitives instead of a new canonical component.
Use Poodle `FormLayout` as the default field layout surface, with `FieldSet` only for semantic grouping. Raw `Grid` is reserved for genuinely custom, non-form arrangements.
Treat as card-plus-layout composition over existing Poodle surfaces.
Use the existing detail-row contract or simple composition instead of adding a second detail item surface.
Use the existing detail-section contract with composition for the internal layout rather than minting a second section type.
Use layout primitives plus repeated detail rows instead of a dedicated detail-list contract.
The existing detail-row surface appears sufficient for the generic label-value use case.
Use `ListCard` plus standard slots/composition instead of introducing a dedicated inline-list-card contract.
Treat as list-item composition over existing list/card, checkbox, button, and pill primitives.
Use existing inline layout or toolbar-style composition rather than adding a dedicated action-group contract.
Treat batch confirmation as a caller-owned `AlertDialog` configuration, not a separate Poodle component.
Direct replacement. Poodle `Dialog` now carries the generic surface-class and close-button affordances that were previously keeping the Underlay wrapper alive.
Direct replacement. Poodle `AlertDialog` now supports async `onConfirm` workflows and controlled close behavior, so the Underlay wrapper no longer owns unique generic behavior.
Use `Toolbar`, `Stack`, and `Spacer` composition for aligned action rows instead of retaining a separate Underlay wrapper.
Use Poodle grid layout primitives directly for two-column responsive container layouts.
Use Poodle `Grid` with card/list composition rather than retaining a second list-grid implementation.
Use Poodle action-row composition instead of a dedicated Underlay card-actions wrapper.
Use Poodle card treatment directly for operational summary cards instead of preserving a separate Underlay card primitive.
Use Poodle grid layout primitives for operations-card layout instead of keeping a second grid wrapper.
Fold the useful loading and submit ergonomics into Poodle `Button` itself; do not mint a separate submit-button surface.
Use `Menu` plus clipboard and toast helpers. Shared action vocabularies should live in app-level composition rather than a canonical design-system wrapper.
Use `Menu` plus dialog composition. Entity-specific action sets should remain in app-level shared components instead of becoming a Poodle composite.
Drop as a named component. Express the pattern through `Toolbar`, `Card` or `Surface`, and text-treatment composition instead of preserving a dedicated diagnostics wrapper.
Treat `PaginatedList` as folded into the Poodle-native `ListContainer` direction rather than preserving a separate canonical paginated-list surface.

resolved_from_poodle_review.notes: Folded into Poodle Field as the `hint` prop. Progressive-disclosure help text shown via tooltip on the info icon next to the label.
Form-level error display maps to Callout with tone="danger" or FormLayout's error prop. No new Poodle surface needed.
Direct replacement. Poodle FieldSet provides semantic <fieldset> + <legend> with grid layout. Props: legend, columns, gap, span.

keep_in_underlay_after_assessment.notes: These are better treated as Underlay or app-level helpers for now. They are either framework-oriented behavior wrappers, content-orchestration surfaces, or tabs-validation helpers rather than clean design-system contracts.

candidate_to_keep_in_underlay.notes: These currently look more like Underlay- or app-level orchestration surfaces than clean design-system contracts. Keep them out of the first Poodle gap batch unless a tighter cross-app contract is written first.

delete.notes: No long-term Underlay ownership intended. Remove or fold into neighboring Poodle-backed surfaces during migration.

next_step: Use the new Poodle-native `ListContainer` as the replacement target for remaining Underlay `ListContainer` and `PaginatedList` usage in consuming apps. Keep treating `DiagnosticsToolbar`, `SubmitButton`, `CopyActionsMenu`, and `EntityActionsMenu` as primitive ergonomics or composition guidance rather than new canonical Poodle components.
